limitations: Both rates are NULL below 100 plays (denominator guard); coloured only by evidence tier, not creator size. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of share_rate against save_rate for every code where both rates clear the 100-play denominator guard, coloured by evidence tier (engine.corpus.tiers).
title: Share rate vs save rate
